premises.text: Traditional remittances force recipients into agency visits, long waits, separate bill-pay trips, and high Western Union fees
premises.evidence_span: They have to pay for a bus to go to an agency, wait online for two hours, then go to another agency to pay their utility bills

premises.text: Immigrants send SMS-usable credit to family phones in Latin America to pay for food, medicine, utilities, and tuition like a gift card
premises.evidence_span: hardworking immigrants can send a credit directly to their family cell phone in Latin America

premises.text: Senders reach Regali online or at partner mom-and-pop stores that trigger instant SMS pins for recipients
premises.evidence_span: Our customers can visit us online or can visit us offline at one of 200 partner mom and pop stores

premises.text: Recipients can transfer part of funds to other family or friends, building a viral social network on remittances
premises.evidence_span: transfer part of those funds to a family member or another friend

premises.text: Contracts covering thousands of retail locations across countries plus retailer fees subsidize a low flat customer fee
premises.evidence_span: we already have the contracts that gives us access to 7,200 retail locations in eight different countries

domains.name: retail contracts and subsidized flat fee

value.text: Immigrants can pay for family's basic needs back home via SMS without agency friction
value.evidence_span: We allow immigrants to pay for all of their family's basic needs back home, all via an SMS

causal_links.evidence_span: Western Union taxes them up to 10%
send a credit directly to their family cell phone in Latin America
a low flat fee of just $3, up to 70% cheaper than any alternative
each of these retailers pay us a fee. which allow us to subsidize how much we charge our customers

notes: Agency bus/wait/bill-pay and Western Union fee folded as one remittance problem (§4.1.6). SMS credit, store/online send, and viral transfer folded as remittance product cascade; retail contracts+fee subsidy kept as commercial/supply module with explicit enablement link. Growth metrics excluded (§4.2). Anti-template: problem, product, and retail economics separately revisable.
